description: Lists aicut's AI Video Story series (niches): episodic short-video formats that generate a whole multi-scene episode from one idea. BROWSING IS `browse_series`' JOB: when the USER is choosing a series ('what series do you have'), call `browse_series` FIRST (a series is chosen BY EYE). THIS TOOL IS THE DATA READ behind that choice (prices, the duration ladder) and the fallback with no cards. Never paste `preview_url` / `preview_video_url` into the chat, dump the catalogue, or call this once per series. TWO CALLS. WITHOUT `series_id`: the COMPACT CATALOG, a shortlist in the picker's order: `id`, `name`, `tagline`, `preview_url` + `preview_video_url`, `rank`, `badge`, `frames_first`, `cast` (`required` / `writer_owned`), `defaults.video_model` and `episode_tokens` (a rough `min`-`max` token range at the default length, frames and scene videos only, so an understatement). `cast`, `defaults` and `episode_tokens` are NULL when the series cannot be fully described: say nothing about its cost and fetch the full entry. With no card, present 3-5 that fit (name, pitch, `episode_tokens`) and the count of the rest. WITH `series_id`: that ONE series IN FULL, REQUIRED before you quote or create anything (never quote money off the compact list). PASS `video_model` (the series' `defaults.video_model` unless the user named one): a full entry carries about ninety ladder rungs across every model. PRICING (only on the `series_id` call): `pricing.video_models[].durations` is the length PICKER, each option a real length in `seconds` with `scene_count`, `frames_tokens` (at create), `videos_tokens` (at fire) and `total_tokens`; `durations.default_seconds` is the default. Also `pricing.start_frame_models`, `pricing.frame_regen_tokens` (one redraw) and `pricing.render_tokens_per_minute` (the final render: the only quote before the scene videos are done; give it as a rate or a rough figure with a tilde, never as the price). Any block can be NULL: a null is not a zero and not a guess, so use `estimate_only`; if `durations` is null the series cannot be sized from here (point at the web app). QUOTE A RUNG HONESTLY, TWO FLAGS THAT ARE NOT THE SAME QUESTION: `videos_estimated` (tilde `videos_tokens`) and `frames_estimated` (tilde `frames_tokens`); tilde the total whenever EITHER is true, even when `exact` is true. `exact` is true on every shipped rung; if one is not, quote `estimate_only`. `scene_count_estimated` true means `scene_count` is what the rung derives, not what the episode will contain. Never state a scene count as fact: it is only what a rung derives and the writer decides; do not volunteer it. `duration` and `scene_count` are INFORMATIONAL (no argument matches them): the sizing question is LENGTH in seconds. Use the series' `defaults` unless the user names a model; when `defaults` is null omit the model arguments. The flow: `get_recipe` `story-episode`.

series_id.description: A series id from the compact catalog: returns that ONE series with every field a quote or create needs. Omit for the compact catalog.

video_model.description: The model you intend to create on (the series' `defaults.video_model` unless the user named one): only its duration ladder comes back. Omit only to compare models. Needs `series_id`; a model the series does not publish is refused with the ones it does.
